biography.text: Born in 1964 in Queens, New York. Cecchi earned a B.A. from Barnard College (1986) and a J.D. from Fordham University School of Law (1989). She served as an assistant corporation counsel in New York City, practiced in Newark, and was a District of New Jersey magistrate judge from 2006 until her elevation. President Obama nominated her.
